name: @aimark/schema
description: JSON Schemas for aiMark data contracts — source of truth shared between Go and TS via codegen

scripts.lint: prettier --check src schemas && tsc --noEmit && bun run codegen:check
scripts.format: prettier --write src schemas && tsc --noEmit && bun run codegen:check
scripts.codegen: for s in run.v1 suite-manifest.v1 samples.v1; do json2ts --input schemas/$s.json --output src/generated/$s.ts --bannerComment "/* Generated from schemas/$s.json — do not edit. Run \`mise run codegen\`. */"; done && prettier --write src/generated
scripts.codegen:check: bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated || (echo 'Generated types are stale. Run `mise run codegen` and commit.' && exit 1)
